Specifically, the grid points involved are those at distances corresponding to indices i-1 (distance ~1 to 2), i (distance 0 to 1), i+1 (distance 0 to 1), and i+2 (distance 1 to 2). Thus, the computation requires values from grid points at indices i-1, i, i+1, and i+2.
